baseline: existing 14D means/Rubato median abs and p95-p5; equal weights for five blocks; pedaling subchannels averaged
strict_dynamics: mean gap <= 5% average width and width gap <= 5% maximum width
divergence: Dynamics lag1 gap >= .2 full; same signed gap >= .1 in each original half; different composers; choose minimum baseline distance among qualifying pairs
consistency: Dynamics lag1 gap <= .05 full and <= .1 each half; large ratio gap <= .01; positive and negative observed run mean ratios <=1.2; different composers; choose minimum baseline distance
undefined: NaN is excluded with denominators; level-run comparison requires >=20 runs per side in main aggregate
limits: Exploratory matched-pair numeric explanation; no preference/listening/style truth
Existing per-work normalization uses cohort; structure and beat duration differences remain
Pair observations are dependent; no significance claim
Half comparisons are within the same recordings and not independent evaluation
